beats.say: Formula 1 is officially heading to Africa in the 2030s.
The sport has signed a 10-year deal with Rwanda starting in the early 2030s.
Formula 1 has not raced on the continent since the 1993 South African Grand Prix.
Lewis Hamilton has campaigned for an African race for many years.
Hamilton is currently contracted with Ferrari until the end of the 2027 season.
The Guardian reports he aims to extend his career to race in the African Grand Prix.
